county.title: County
county.description: Filter to one Florida county by property location (e.g. Orange, Osceola, Dade, Monroe, St. Johns). Leave empty for statewide.

city.title: City
city.description: Filter by property location city (e.g. Kissimmee, Orlando, Destin). Leave empty for all.

status.title: License status
status.description: Current = up to date with DBPR; Delinquent = license not renewed on time (expiry date has passed).

licenseType.title: License type
licenseType.description: DBPR licenses vacation rentals as Condos (type 2006) or Dwellings (type 2007, incl. single-family homes & townhouses).

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the business name or licensee name.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: The state site blocks plain datacenter traffic; Apify Proxy is used by default. Switch to residential if datacenter IPs get blocked.
